item.description: Check your lottery tickets! item.title: Shooting star? Midwesterners report seeing fireball in the sky Tuesday night
item.description: Social media users were buzzing Tuesday night after some said they spotted what appeared to be a shooting star in the sky. According to the American Meteor Society, what people saw was in fact a shooting star, more scientifically considered a fireball, or bright meteor.More than 128 people across Illinois, Indiana, Kentucky, Ohio and Wisconsin reported seeing the fireball around 10:31 p.m. CT Tuesday. item.title: Love letters from prominent Chinatown couple on display at Chinese American Museum
item.description: More than 300 love letters exchanged in the 1960s between longtime Chinatown leaders Bernie and Albert Wong are now on display at the Chinese American Museum of Chicago in an exhibit titled "All My Love." The collection reveals the couple’s early romance and shared commitment to community service, offering a rare glimpse into expressions of love among an older Chinese American generation.Bernie and Albert Wong were married more than 50 years. item.title: Celtics beat injury-riddled Bulls 124-105 as Vucevic scores 19 against his former team
item.description: Payton Pritchard scored 26 points and the Boston Celtics rolled past the Chicago Bulls 124-105 on Wednesday night in the final game for both teams before the All-Star break.Jaylen Brown added 24 points. Nikola Vucevic finished with 19 points and 11 rebounds for the Celtics, who have won six of their last seven games.The Celtics carried a 28-point into halftime, taking advantage of a Chicagos team that was missing several top contributors.
